subject: Clarify reseller billing claim flow & MSA redlines for marketplace addendum
messages:
From: Samantha Greene <samantha@orioncloud.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: marketplace-legal@orioncloud.com, chris.patel@resellco.com
Date: 2028-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace addendum — billing responsibility and evidence path

Marissa / Redwood team,

Thanks for the call this morning. We reviewed the draft addendum and have two high-level questions before legal will sign off:

1) Who is the invoice owner for marketplace transactions (Reseller -> Redwood or Marketplace -> Reseller)? Our billing ops need a clear owner to route tax/VAT and refund flows.
2) On audit/evidence (we saw the passback language), what proof will Redwood provide when a reseller requests a chargeback? Do you have a standard evidence package or SLA for these requests?

Attached is a short list of items our procurement team expects. If you can confirm by EOD Tues, that would keep us on track for the May launch.

Best,
Samantha Greene
Head of Cloud Partnerships — OrionCloud
attachments: onboarding_requirements.pdf (pdf)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: Samantha Greene <samantha@orioncloud.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — billing responsibility and evidence path

Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, details below:

- Invoice ownership: Redwood recommends marketplace -> reseller (marketplace issues the customer invoice, reseller is paid via passback), but we can support reseller-invoice flows if Orion requires seller-side invoicing.
- Evidence package: Redwood will provide per-claim KV logs, order id mapping, and token/usage CSV export. We can commit to delivery within 5 business days for standard requests; expedited (48h) is available for escalations.

I'll loop Ben and Laura to propose exact redlines on the Order Form + MSA language (liability carveouts, audit-trigger scope).

Marissa
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-02T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace addendum — suggested redlines (draft)

Folks — forwarding Samantha's ask + my quick suggestions. See inline below and the separate draft MSA_redlines_v2.docx attached to this thread. Key points I recommend we push back on:

- Limit audit-trigger to charges > $5k or after 2 failed reconciliations (otherwise ops gets flooded).
- Make passback evidence "reasonable technical logs and mappings" rather than an open data dump; include an explicit list (order id, timestamp, usage bucket, token counts).
- Preserve Redwood indemnity carveouts for third-party infra.

Please review the doc and add comments directly — need a consolidated position by Monday.

Ben
Head of Partnerships Ops
Redwood Inference
attachments: MSA_redlines_v2.docx (docx)

From: Samantha Greene <samantha@orioncloud.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: marketplace-legal@orioncloud.com, chris.patel@resellco.com
Date: 2028-04-03T10:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — billing responsibility and evidence path

Marissa/Ben — thanks. A couple follow-ups from procurement/legal: 

- The audit threshold sounds reasonable, but Orion will want an exception carve for suspected fraud or regulatory subpoenas (no threshold). Can Redwood accept an exception for lawful process?
- For the evidence package, our finance team needs transaction-level mappings back to the customer invoice (so we can reconcile VAT and refunds). Token counts are helpful, but invoice line linkage is critical.

Also copying Chris from our reseller (ResellCo); they asked whether Redwood can host the reconciliation CSV on a secure share or if everything must be pulled by Orion.

Samantha

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Samantha Greene <samantha@orioncloud.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-04T14:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — billing responsibility and evidence path

Samantha — appreciate the clarity. Quick read on the legal redlines: 

- Exception carve for lawful process: acceptable as long as data transfer is limited to the minimum necessary and covered by a DPA addendum; propose: "lawful process exception — Redwood may produce minimal data required by subpoena with notice to Orion where permitted."
- Transaction linkage: we can produce an OrderForm_annotated.pdf and a reconciliation CSV that maps internal usage ids to customer invoice line items. Hosting options: Redwood secure SFTP or presigned link to an encrypted object store. Which is easier for Orion ops?

Operational note: our standard turnaround for a reconciliation CSV is 3 business days after a formal request with order identifiers. Expedited handling is available for high-severity incidents.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: chris.patel@resellco.com
To: Samantha Greene <samantha@orioncloud.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-05T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — billing responsibility and evidence path

Laura / Redwood team — quick confirmation from ResellCo: SFTP hosting works for us; presigned links are OK for individual extracts but SFTP preferred for regular reconciliations. Also confirming we accept the proposed audit threshold with the lawful-process carve you outlined.

Next steps proposed by ResellCo:
- Laura/Ben: include the SFTP option in the Order Form redline and show example field mapping in the reconciliation CSV.
- Marissa: can you confirm commercial impact (if any) of the $5k audit threshold and 3-day delivery SLA? We need that for our procurement queue.

Thanks,
Chris Patel
Finance Ops — ResellCo
attachments: none
